_comment: BYBIT_SHARED_LIMITER_ALL_CONSUMERS_ALIGNMENT_V1 (Issue #253) — CANONICAL, git-versioned parameters for the shared Bybit rate limiter. Activate a consumer by adding {"global_limiter_contract_path": "<path to this file>", "global_bybit_rate_limiter_enabled": true} to THAT consumer's config file. Activation is never carried by this file (staged rollout stays per-consumer). A relative global_limiter_state_path is anchored at the repository root, never at the process cwd. Production deployments ship their own copy with the absolute state path /var/lib/trad_bot/state/global_bybit_limiter_v1.json and point global_limiter_contract_path at it. This file is never mutated at runtime.
